Fixture: 00_signature_naked.bin
Provenance: hand-authored, signature only, not a decodable stream.
Size: 6 bytes.

Exact bytes:

    ff 0a 00 11 22 33

  ff 0a  JPEG XL naked-codestream marker (ISO/IEC 18181-1). Every bare
         codestream begins with these two bytes and nothing else precedes them.
  00 11 22 33
         Arbitrary filler. These bytes are NOT a valid image header; they exist
         only so the fixture is longer than its signature, which exercises the
         "signature plus trailing data" path in `jpxl_conformance::sniff`.

Expected classification: StreamKind::NakedCodestream.

Do NOT feed this to a decoder and expect success: it is deliberately not a
decodable stream. Written by hand with printf(1); no third-party file was
copied, converted, or consulted to produce it.
